title: Hearty British Steamed Spotted Dick
description: A traditional British dessert featuring ground ginger and steamed to perfection, this spotted dick is a cultured and snappy treat, wood-fired-baked and nut-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the suet, brown sugar, ground ginger, and mixed spice.
Add the dried fruit, brandy, eggs, and milk to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Wrap the dough in parchment paper and steam for 2 hours.
Remove the spotted dick from the steamer and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the spotted dick warm, sliced and topped with custard or cream.
If desired, bake the spotted dick in the wood-fired oven for an additional 10 minutes to give it a crispy crust.
Let the spotted dick cool completely before storing it in an airtight container.
